rules.message: NOLOCK and READ UNCOMMITTED read uncommitted rows, and a scan can read a row two times or miss it.
rules.fix: Turn on READ_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT for the database (DATA-26) and remove the hint.
match: SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;
nomatch: ALTER DATABASE CURRENT SET READ_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT ON WITH ROLLBACK IMMEDIATE;

rules.message: MERGE without HOLDLOCK lets two sessions insert the same new key (error 2627).
rules.fix: Write MERGE <table> WITH (HOLDLOCK) AS t USING ..., or UPDATE WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) then INSERT in one transaction. Ignore with a reason when only one writer exists.
match: MERGE dbo.StockLevels AS t USING (VALUES (@sku, @available)) AS s (Sku, Available)

MERGE INTO StockLevels t
    USING src s ON t.Sku = s.Sku
nomatch: MERGE dbo.StockLevels WITH (HOLDLOCK) AS t USING (VALUES (@sku, @available)) AS s (Sku, Available)
MERGE dbo.StockLevels WITH (UPDLOCK, SERIALIZABLE) t USING src s ON t.Sku = s.Sku

rules.message: AddWithValue sends a string as nvarchar with the length of the value. On a varchar column, SQL Server converts the column and cannot seek the index, and each length gets its own plan.
rules.fix: Use Parameters.Add("@sku", SqlDbType.VarChar, 32).Value = sku, or Dapper DbString { IsAnsi = true, Length = 32 }.
nomatch: var p = new SqlParameter("@sku", SqlDbType.VarChar, 32) { Value = sku };

rules.message: AT TIME ZONE takes only Windows zone names from sys.time_zone_info. An IANA name fails with error 9820.
rules.fix: Use the Windows name, for example 'W. Europe Standard Time' for Europe/Amsterdam.
match: CAST(o.PlacedAt AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam' AS date)
nomatch: CAST(o.PlacedAt AT TIME ZONE 'W. Europe Standard Time' AS date)

rules.message: Dynamic SQL built by concatenation with a variable is SQL injection.
rules.fix: Use sp_executesql with the value as a parameter. Check an identifier against an allow list and wrap it in QUOTENAME.
match: N'SELECT Sku FROM dbo.StockLevels WHERE Sku LIKE ''' + @SkuPrefix + N'%'''
nomatch: EXEC sp_executesql N'SELECT Sku FROM dbo.StockLevels WHERE Sku LIKE @prefix', N'@prefix varchar(33)', @prefix = @p;

rules.message: datetime has a precision of about 3 ms, no time zone, and a small range. GETDATE() gives the local time of the server.
rules.fix: Use datetimeoffset (or datetime2 in UTC) with SYSUTCDATETIME() or SYSDATETIMEOFFSET().

match: ALTER DATABASE CURRENT SET READ_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT ON WITH ROLLBACK IMMEDIATE;
ALTER DATABASE CURRENT SET OPTIMIZED_LOCKING = ON;
using var bulk = new SqlBulkCopy(connection, SqlBulkCopyOptions.CheckConstraints, transaction);
